create.name: Adi Kanda
create.bio:
Adi Kanda’s story begins on a cold January morning in 2000, when she opened her eyes to find pages of writing in her bedside journal — writing she had no memory of producing. That spontaneous awakening opened a channel that has never closed: in the twenty-five years since, Adi has received thousands of sacred, poetic transmissions, moving over time from sleep-state writing into conscious reception, and building alongside them a quarter-century practice of deep energy work — releasing, as she describes it, karmic patterns at a cellular level. Her signature Kore readings have reached clients worldwide, many of whom describe them as liberating beyond any modality they have known; her transmissions have been shared in workshops, performances, and salons, carrying what listeners describe as an activating frequency that opens the heart and often brings them to tears.

An author, intuitive, practitioner, and mother of three based in Toronto, Adi gathered the first curated harvest of her life’s receiving into Dear Human Child: Love Letters From the Divine (2025) — Book One of a planned trilogy for what she calls our days of the great Shift. Direct, nuanced, and profound, the writings weave metaphysical wisdom with literary grace — examining duality and division, sexual life-force, death and rebirth, and the courage to unravel our karmic wounds — and her publisher places the book squarely in the lineage of the Tao Te Ching, A Course in Miracles, and Conversations with God: words meant to be read aloud, contemplated, and embodied. More than a book, she offers it as energy medicine — whispers, as she frames it, from our Creator to our deepest heart.

books.title: Dear Human Child: Love Letters from the Divine, Book One
books.author: Adi Kanda
books.description: Dear Human Child is the first curated harvest of twenty-five years of received transmissions. It is a set of poetic love letters from the Divine, written to be read aloud, contemplated and embodied. It explores duality and division, sexual life-force, death and rebirth, and the courage to unravel our karmic wounds, offered as energy medicine for the days of the great Shift.

books.title: Monster Most Feared: Love Letters from the Divine, Book Two
books.author: Adi Kanda
books.description: The second book of the trilogy turns toward the Shadow, the fears, traumas and forces we label dark or evil. Its transmissions cover apocalypse, pandemic, addiction, mental illness and the nature of evil, and include personal letters for anyone who has lost faith. It presents facing and integrating our shadows as a path to healing and liberation.

courses.title: ADITUM Membership
courses.description: A monthly community for exploring the teachings of Dear Human Child and Monster Most Feared. Members join two 90-minute Zoom calls a month with card readings, live transmissions and automatic writing, plus a private WhatsApp group. Each member also gets a physical Love Letter by post every month, and Toronto members can come to in-person gatherings every second month.

courses.title: Soul Forge: Inner Mastery for Conscious Leaders
courses.description: A four-month intensive for high-achieving leaders and creatives, limited to four people per cohort. It combines all four of Adi’s initiatory readings (Kore, Blessing, SASS and Vision) with 16 private sessions and 16 weekly group salons. Through shadow work and energy work, it guides people out of fear-based patterns and into purpose. Entry is by application and a discovery call.

courses.title: Dear Human Child Audio Series
courses.description: 24 recordings of Adi reading each transmission from Dear Human Child aloud, with her own reflections. The recordings are meant to be used as meditation and as a healing tool.
